newsitem.title: JORDAN: Qatari crown prince, foreign minister in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Qatari crown prince, foreign minister in Jordan.

text.p: Qatar's Crown Prince Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani arrived in Jordan on Wednesday for talks with King Hussein.
Jordanian officials said the teenage crown prince, third son of the Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, was making his first foreign trip since he was appointed heir in October.
He was accompanied by Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani on a two-day visit to improve bilateral ties and exchange views on the Middle East peace process.
Jordan, in a drive to enhance relations, was among the first states that recognised the new Qatari government after the present Emir ousted his father in a bloodless coup in June 1995.
King Hussein visited Qatar last year along with Bahrain, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.

He has been trying to patch up differences with the Gulf states, once his main financial supporters, who were angered because of his backing for Baghdad after Iraq invaded Kuwait in August 1990, sparking the Gulf crisis.
